# Test fixtures

- `attestation-development.json`, `attestation-production.json`: real App Attest attestations from
  [node-app-attest](https://www.npmjs.com/package/node-app-attest) (MIT). Team `V8H6LQ9448`, bundle `io.uebelacker.AppAttestExample`.
- `apple-real-chain.json`: Apple's App Store signing leaf and WWDR intermediate certificates, taken from the
  tests of [@apple/app-store-server-library](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@apple/app-store-server-library) (MIT, © 2023 Apple Inc.).
